_comment: The courier's audio log in motel room 7 (Act 1, D110). Same mechanism as scene_box.json
(D102): the shard prop (ac_courier_shard in source/world.json) is scenery, and this
scene hangs one Take prompt on it with an attachToWorld choice hub.
The quest graph's take_courier_log node blocks on this scene until the option is
picked, then give_courier_log puts the shard in V's inventory. Reading it sets
ashcache_courier_log_played (glue.json, journal Visited), which releases await_room.

nodes._attachToWorld: offset is relative to the scene location #ac_shard_origin, which sits on the shard itself; 0.1 m up keeps the prompt on it. range is vanilla hub 4162's 2 m.
